ability.delegate-to-the-intern.name: Delegate to the Intern
ability.delegate-to-the-intern.desc: Calls in the intern, who stands in the way and takes the hits. Throw the intern and you'll be judged.
ability.scarab-swarm.name: Scarab Swarm
ability.scarab-swarm.desc: Four scarabs scuttle out of an old jar, slowing and nibbling anyone nearby.
ability.re-entry.name: Re-entry
ability.re-entry.desc: Leaps across the room and lands on someone, hard.
ability.rolling-pin-spin.name: Rolling Pin Spin
ability.rolling-pin-spin.desc: Spins with the rolling pin out, knocking back everyone close.
ability.oat-milk-spill.name: Oat Milk Spill
ability.oat-milk-spill.desc: Knocks over a jug of oat milk. It gets everywhere.
ability.honey-trap.name: Honey Trap
ability.honey-trap.desc: Pours out a sticky patch of honey that glues people in place.
ability.scaffold-collapse.name: Scaffold Collapse
ability.scaffold-collapse.desc: Brings a stack of planks down on an area.
ability.emergency-brake.name: Emergency Brake
ability.emergency-brake.desc: Charges forward and stops very suddenly, into someone.
ability.sawhorse-barricade.name: Sawhorse Barricade
ability.sawhorse-barricade.desc: Throws up a barricade in someone's path. They trip over it.
ability.le-petit-chef.name: Le Petit Chef
ability.le-petit-chef.desc: A rat in a chef's hat pesters an opponent and steals whatever they're holding.
ability.up-the-flue.name: Up the Flue
ability.up-the-flue.desc: Hooks someone with the brush, drags them in and covers them in soot.
ability.balloon-animal.name: Balloon Animal
ability.balloon-animal.desc: Twists up a balloon dog that everyone wants to pop. It goes off with a bang.
ability.birds-arent-real.name: Birds Aren't Real
ability.birds-arent-real.desc: Two surveillance pigeons circle the room, distracting everyone. Told you.
ability.van-door-slam.name: Van Door Slam
ability.van-door-slam.desc: Flings a van door open into whoever's standing there.
ability.open-wide.name: Open Wide
ability.open-wide.desc: Grabs someone, looks inside and tuts. They're frozen with embarrassment.
ability.fog-machine.name: Fog Machine
ability.fog-machine.desc: Fills the area with fog. Nobody can see who they're hitting.
ability.release-the-poodle.name: Release the Poodle
ability.release-the-poodle.desc: An immaculately groomed poodle goes for the ankles.
ability.tripped-breaker.name: Tripped Breaker
ability.tripped-breaker.desc: Flips the breaker: everyone nearby jolts to a stop, wet people most of all.
ability.load-bearing-wall.name: Load-Bearing Wall
ability.load-bearing-wall.desc: Builds a quick bit of cover and braces behind it.
ability.stress-test.name: Stress Test
ability.stress-test.desc: Finds the weak point. The next few hits land harder.
ability.goose-on-the-loose.name: Goose on the Loose
ability.goose-on-the-loose.desc: Lets the goose out. The goose chooses violence.
ability.runway-walk.name: Runway Walk
ability.runway-walk.desc: Struts right up to someone and makes them feel underdressed.
ability.ladder-swing.name: Ladder Swing
ability.ladder-swing.desc: Swings the ladder in a wide arc. Mind your heads.
ability.oxygen-masks.name: Oxygen Masks
ability.oxygen-masks.desc: Masks drop for the whole team: a quick breath, a bit of health, back on your feet.
ability.butterfly-effect.name: Butterfly Effect
ability.butterfly-effect.desc: Releases butterflies that distract enemies and cheer up the team.
ability.one-star.name: One Star
ability.one-star.desc: Posts a one-star review of someone, in public, during the fight.
ability.send-it-back.name: Send It Back
ability.send-it-back.desc: Rejects whatever the target is holding, then them.
ability.crossed-path.name: Crossed Path
ability.crossed-path.desc: Two black cats cross the enemies' path. Bad luck follows.
ability.prickly-customer.name: Prickly Customer
ability.prickly-customer.desc: A hedgehog wanders into the fight. Hit it and you'll regret it.
ability.blow-dry-blast.name: Blow-Dry Blast
ability.blow-dry-blast.desc: A hairdryer on full blast: pushed back and hair everywhere.
ability.bellhop.name: Bellhop!
ability.bellhop.desc: Rings for the bellhop, who barges through with the luggage.
ability.seagull-magnet.name: Seagull Magnet
ability.seagull-magnet.desc: Holds up a cone. Seagulls arrive and take everything that isn't nailed down.
ability.fan-meet-up.name: Fan Meet-Up
ability.fan-meet-up.desc: Two superfans turn up, get in the way and hype the influencer up.
ability.out-of-order.name: Out of Order
ability.out-of-order.desc: Puts up an out-of-order sign in the middle of the fight. People trip over it.
ability.hot-take.name: Hot Take
ability.hot-take.desc: Publishes a hot take about everyone nearby. Morale drops.
ability.discovery.name: Discovery
ability.discovery.desc: A paralegal arrives with boxes of documents and leaves paper everywhere.
ability.late-fees.name: Late Fees
ability.late-fees.desc: Calculates someone's late fees out loud. Their energy drains away.
ability.vision-board.name: Vision Board
ability.vision-board.desc: Shows the team the vision board. Everyone feels unstoppable.
ability.cold-shower.name: Cold Shower
ability.cold-shower.desc: A bracing cold shower: shakes off burning, slowing and embarrassment.
ability.whistle-blast.desc: A piercing whistle. Everyone nearby freezes.
ability.pick-a-card-any-rabbit.name: Pick a Card, Any Rabbit
ability.pick-a-card-any-rabbit.desc: Pulls three rabbits out of a hat. They go everywhere.
ability.crab-pot.name: Crab Pot
ability.crab-pot.desc: Opens a crab pot. Two crabs go for the nearest ankles.
ability.jack-it-up.name: Jack It Up
ability.jack-it-up.desc: Jacks someone up in the air, then lets them down. Suddenly.
ability.trapped-in-a-box.name: Trapped in a Box
ability.trapped-in-a-box.desc: Traps someone in an invisible box. They believe it.
ability.guided-tour.name: Guided Tour
ability.guided-tour.desc: Leads a tour group straight through the fight. They stop to look at everything.
ability.bed-rest.name: Bed Rest
ability.drop-cloth.name: Drop Cloth
ability.drop-cloth.desc: Throws a dust sheet over someone. They wander about blindly.
ability.stretcher-run.name: Stretcher Run
ability.stretcher-run.desc: Sprints to a hurt teammate and patches them up.
ability.burpees.name: Burpees!
ability.burpees.desc: Makes everyone nearby do burpees. They're exhausted; the trainer is pumped.
ability.u-bend-launch.name: U-Bend Launch
ability.u-bend-launch.desc: Clears the blockage. The blockage is a person.
ability.kettle.name: Kettle
ability.kettle.desc: Surrounds everyone nearby and moves them along, slowly.
ability.canvassing.name: Canvassing
ability.canvassing.desc: Two campaign volunteers hand leaflets to anyone who'll stand still.
ability.u-turn.name: U-Turn
ability.u-turn.desc: Pulls someone close, then completely changes position on them.
ability.signed-for.name: Signed For
ability.signed-for.desc: Please sign here. And here. And here.
ability.its-not-a-bug.name: It's Not a Bug
ability.its-not-a-bug.desc: Releases three bugs into the fight. They're features, apparently.
ability.inkblot-test.name: Inkblot Test
ability.inkblot-test.desc: Shows someone an inkblot. They can't stop thinking about it.
ability.group-therapy.name: Group Therapy
ability.group-therapy.desc: Everyone shares. Everyone feels a bit better.
ability.pieces-of-eight.name: Pieces of Eight
ability.pieces-of-eight.desc: The ship's parrot follows an opponent around, repeating everything embarrassing.
ability.lab-rats.name: Lab Rats
ability.lab-rats.desc: Three escaped lab rats run under everyone's feet.
ability.pat-down.name: Pat Down
ability.pat-down.desc: A thorough pat-down. Whatever they were holding is confiscated.
ability.measure-you-up.name: Measure You Up
ability.measure-you-up.desc: Wraps a tape measure round someone and reels them in.
ability.flash-sheet.name: Flash Sheet
ability.flash-sheet.desc: Shows off the flash sheet. Enemies nearby lose their nerve.
ability.meters-running.name: Meter's Running
ability.meters-running.desc: Starts the meter. Everyone nearby slows down and pays for it.
ability.school-trip.name: School Trip
ability.school-trip.desc: Four schoolkids on a trip run riot through the fight.
ability.studio-audience.name: Studio Audience
ability.studio-audience.desc: A studio audience cheers on the host's team and boos the rest.
ability.and-were-back.name: And We're Back!
ability.and-were-back.desc: Bursts back in after the break, straight at someone.
ability.therapy-dog.name: Therapy Dog
ability.therapy-dog.desc: A calm therapy dog helps the team recover. Enemies can't resist going for it.
ability.sparks-fly.name: Sparks Fly
ability.sparks-fly.desc: A shower of sparks across everyone in front.
ability.pigeons-on-the-ledge.name: Pigeons on the Ledge
ability.pigeons-on-the-ledge.desc: Disturbs three pigeons, who spend the fight getting in people's faces.
ability.enrichment-programme.name: Enrichment Programme
ability.enrichment-programme.desc: Lets out a capybara (usually) or a dik-dik (sometimes).
ability.lifeguard-whistle.name: Whistle Blast
ability.lifeguard-whistle.desc: A piercing whistle. Everyone nearby freezes.
ability.paparazzi-swarm.name: Paparazzi
ability.paparazzi-swarm.desc: Two paparazzi hound an opponent with flashbulbs.
ability.please-mind-the-gap.name: Mind the Gap
ability.please-mind-the-gap.desc: Everyone in a line ahead falls into the gap.
trait.ailurophobe.name: Ailurophobe
trait.ailurophobe.desc: Has been hounded by one too many black cats. Now panics around them.
trait.pigeon-ptsd.name: Pigeon PTSD
trait.pigeon-ptsd.desc: Pecked, swooped and robbed by birds. Now flinches at every flap.
trait.stage-fright.name: Stage Fright
trait.stage-fright.desc: Crowds, cameras and fans have taken their toll. Freezes up in front of people.
hr.accountant-audit-season.name: Has Seen Their Expenses
hr.accountant-audit-season.desc: Knows exactly what was claimed for "client lunches". Fights with the calm of someone holding receipts.
hr.accountant-not-the-kids.name: Not the Kids
hr.accountant-not-the-kids.desc: Requested in writing not to be paired with anyone who might bring a school trip.
hr.archaeologist-professional-interest.d: Spends the first minute of every museum fight dating the display cases. Sharper for it.
hr.archaeologist-disputed-provenance.des: Ongoing dispute with Curatorial over who "found" the urn. Neither will discuss it calmly.
hr.astronaut-departure-lounge.name: Frequent Flyer
hr.astronaut-departure-lounge.desc: Treats the airport like the car park outside work. Strolls through security with a nod.
hr.astronaut-moon-landing-questions.name: Asked About the Moon Again
hr.astronaut-moon-landing-questions.desc: Has been asked "but did you really go?" 412 times by one colleague. HR is aware.
hr.baker-4am-flask.name: 4 a.m. Flask
hr.baker-4am-flask.desc: Up since four. As long as there is something hot to sip, there is no tiredness, only dough.
hr.baker-not-a-real-pastry-chef.name: Not a Real Pastry Chef
hr.baker-not-a-real-pastry-chef.desc: Has strong views on chefs who "do desserts". Hits harder, watches less.
hr.barista-tolerance.name: Caffeine Tolerance
hr.barista-tolerance.desc: Energy drinks stopped working in 2019. Now they just make them sad and slightly slower.
hr.barista-knows-your-order.name: Knows Your Order
hr.barista-knows-your-order.desc: Remembers every office worker's order. Office workers would take a chair to the head for them.
hr.beekeeper-pollinator-partnership.name: Pollinator Partnership
hr.beekeeper-pollinator-partnership.desc: Works best with people who keep flowers. The bees are calmer. So is the beekeeper.
hr.beekeeper-liquids-restriction.name: Liquids Restriction
hr.beekeeper-liquids-restriction.desc: Had a jar of honey confiscated at security in 2021. Has not recovered emotionally.
hr.builder-proper-ppe.name: Proper PPE
hr.builder-proper-ppe.desc: Refuses to work without the right kit. With it, frankly unstoppable.
hr.builder-drawings-dont-match.name: Drawings Don't Match
hr.builder-drawings-dont-match.desc: Every job with an engineer turns into a forty-minute argument about the drawings.
hr.bus-driver-rail-replacement.name: Rail Replacement Hero
hr.bus-driver-rail-replacement.desc: The only time the station is glad to see them. Walks the platform like a returning king.
hr.bus-driver-not-on-the-timetable.name: Not on the Timetable
hr.bus-driver-not-on-the-timetable.desc: Temps are always late. The bus waits for no one, and neither does this grudge.
hr.carpenter-measure-twice.name: Measure Twice
hr.carpenter-measure-twice.desc: Around timber and pallets, every throw lands exactly where they measured it would.
hr.carpenter-painted-over-the-grain.name: Painted Over the Grain
hr.carpenter-painted-over-the-grain.desc: A painter once glossed over solid oak. They were working together at the time.
hr.chef-not-my-kitchen.name: Not My Kitchen
hr.chef-not-my-kitchen.desc: Walks into any diner and starts reorganising the kitchen. Strong arms, short temper.
hr.chef-one-star-review.name: One Star Review
hr.chef-one-star-review.desc: Still has the review framed. Upside down. In the bin. Would rather not talk about it.
hr.chimney-sweep-lucky-handshake.name: Lucky Handshake
hr.chimney-sweep-lucky-handshake.desc: Shaking hands with a sweep is lucky. Carrying a charm as well is, apparently, very lucky.
hr.chimney-sweep-soot-on-the-suit.name: Soot on the Suit
hr.chimney-sweep-soot-on-the-suit.desc: Has been told off for "existing near the samples". Now apologises before every fight.
hr.clown-finally-an-audience.name: Finally, an Audience
hr.clown-finally-an-audience.desc: Fourteen years of children's parties. A real stage changes a person.
hr.clown-silent-treatment.name: The Silent Treatment
hr.clown-silent-treatment.desc: The mime hasn't spoken to them since the incident. Technically the mime hasn't spoken to anyone.
Uniforms on the other side. Eyes everywhere, nerves shot.
hr.conspiracy-podcaster-peer-review.name: Peer Review
hr.conspiracy-podcaster-peer-review.desc: Keeps getting "fact-checked" by a teammate. Mid-fight. Out loud.
hr.delivery-driver-own-vehicle.name: Own Vehicle
hr.delivery-driver-own-vehicle.desc: With the keys in their pocket they move like a parcel is about to be marked "missed".
hr.delivery-driver-no-parking.name: Nowhere to Park
hr.delivery-driver-no-parking.desc: Circled the car park for twenty minutes before this fight. Arrived furious.
hr.dentist-sugar-merchants.name: Sugar Merchants
hr.dentist-sugar-merchants.desc: Personally blames the opposition for most of their patients' fillings.
hr.dentist-staining-agent.name: Staining Agent
hr.dentist-staining-agent.desc: Cannot stop staring at a teammate's coffee. Thinking about enamel. Not about the fight.
hr.dj-wedding-season.name: Wedding Season
hr.dj-wedding-season.desc: Played this room before. Knows where the sockets are and when to drop the bass.
hr.dj-shushed.name: Shushed
hr.dj-shushed.desc: Was shushed during a warm-up mix. In front of everyone. The bass has never fully recovered.
hr.dog-groomer-smells-of-poodle.name: Smells of Poodle
hr.dog-groomer-smells-of-poodle.desc: Opponents who fear animals can smell the salon on them. The groomer knows it.
hr.dog-groomer-no-dogs-allowed.name: No Dogs Allowed
hr.dog-groomer-no-dogs-allowed.desc: Signs on the door. Every sign is a personal attack.
hr.electrician-insulated.name: Properly Insulated
hr.electrician-insulated.desc: With the right gloves on, every job is a quick job.
hr.electrician-water-and-electrics.name: Water and Electrics
hr.electrician-water-and-electrics.desc: Will not stand within three metres of a plumber. Professional rule. Bad things happen.
hr.engineer-back-of-envelope.name: Back of the Envelope
hr.engineer-back-of-envelope.desc: Gadgets on the wrist and the maths gets done before the punch lands.
hr.engineer-not-to-spec.name: Not to Spec
hr.engineer-not-to-spec.desc: The builder "improvised" again. The engineer has photos. And a lot of feelings.
hr.farmer-supply-chain-opinions.name: Supply Chain Opinions
hr.farmer-supply-chain-opinions.desc: Has seen the price of milk on the shelf. Hits harder, says ruder things.
hr.farmer-animal-people.name: Animal People
hr.farmer-animal-people.desc: Gets on with anyone who has spent a night in a barn. Fights relaxed.
hr.fashion-designer-runway.name: Born for the Runway
hr.fashion-designer-runway.desc: A long floor and an audience. Walks it like next season depends on it.
hr.fashion-designer-hi-vis-clash.name: Hi-Vis Clash
hr.fashion-designer-hi-vis-clash.desc: Refuses to be photographed within ten metres of high-visibility polyester.
hr.firefighter-blue-light-bond.name: Blue Light Bond
hr.firefighter-blue-light-bond.desc: Fights best next to anyone who has also been called out at 3 a.m.
hr.firefighter-fire-safety-lecture.name: Fire Safety Lecture
hr.firefighter-fire-safety-lecture.desc: Cannot stop thinking about where those cigarettes will end up. Pats every pocket twice.
hr.flight-attendant-crew-lane.name: Crew Lane
hr.flight-attendant-crew-lane.desc: Skips every queue in the building. Knows where every exit is.
hr.flight-attendant-disruptive-passenger: Has a teammate behaving like seat 32B on a delayed flight. Smiling through it. Barely.
hr.florist-pollinators-welcome.name: Pollinators Welcome
hr.florist-pollinators-welcome.desc: Their flowers do better with the right people around. Their luck does too.
hr.florist-no-flowers-on-the-ward.name: No Flowers on the Ward
hr.florist-no-flowers-on-the-ward.desc: Infection control took the bouquet off them at the door.
hr.food-critic-notebook-out.name: Notebook Out
hr.food-critic-notebook-out.desc: Facing a cook. The notebook comes out. Something cruel and perfectly worded is coming.
hr.food-critic-sticky-menus.name: Sticky Menus
hr.food-critic-sticky-menus.desc: The menus are laminated and sticky. They have already started writing the review.
hr.fortune-teller-saw-this-coming.name: Saw This Coming
hr.fortune-teller-saw-this-coming.desc: Charms in the pocket, cards in the sleeve. Fate does what it's told.
hr.fortune-teller-sceptic-in-the-room.de: A teammate asked for "a controlled trial". The spirits have gone quiet.
hr.gardener-fresh-air-people.name: Fresh Air People
hr.gardener-fresh-air-people.desc: Happiest next to anyone with mud on their boots.
hr.gardener-plastic-plants.name: Plastic Plants
hr.gardener-plastic-plants.desc: Noticed the plants are plastic. Has been quietly grieving since.
hr.hairdresser-they-need-a-trim.name: They Need a Trim
hr.hairdresser-they-need-a-trim.desc: Can see the opposition's split ends from across the room. Fights with a professional mission.
hr.hairdresser-sea-air-frizz.name: Sea Air Frizz
hr.hairdresser-sea-air-frizz.desc: Salt and humidity. Their own hair. In public. A disaster.
hr.hotel-concierge-home-turf.name: Home Turf
hr.hotel-concierge-home-turf.desc: Knows every guest, every service door and which carpet hides a step.
hr.hotel-concierge-agency-standards.name: Agency Standards
hr.hotel-concierge-agency-standards.desc: A temp in the squad. Untucked shirt. The concierge apologises to everyone on their behalf.
hr.ice-cream-vendor-seaside-pitch.name: Seaside Pitch
hr.ice-cream-vendor-seaside-pitch.desc: The docks are the best pitch in town. Practically on commission.
hr.ice-cream-vendor-the-enemy.name: The Enemy
hr.ice-cream-vendor-the-enemy.desc: A dentist on the other side. Their whole business model is at stake.
hr.influencer-content-opportunity.name: Content Opportunity
hr.influencer-content-opportunity.desc: Someone with a camera in the squad. Every punch is a thumbnail.
hr.influencer-no-flash-photography.name: No Flash Photography
hr.influencer-no-flash-photography.desc: Phones away, please. Without an audience, who even are they?
hr.janitor-clean-up-aisle-three.name: Clean-up on Aisle Three
hr.janitor-clean-up-aisle-three.desc: Knows every spill, every cupboard and every short cut in the building.
hr.janitor-someone-has-to-clean-that.des: A messy teammate. Guess who'll be mopping afterwards. Guess who's thinking about it.
hr.journalist-exclusive.name: Exclusive
hr.journalist-exclusive.desc: Has a source inside the other team. Probably. Fights like the front page is already written.
hr.journalist-under-injunction.name: Under Injunction
hr.journalist-under-injunction.desc: A colleague served them papers last month. Can't say what about. Legally.
hr.lawyer-know-your-rights.name: Know Your Rights
hr.lawyer-know-your-rights.desc: Facing uniforms. Has quoted the relevant act before the bell rings.
hr.lawyer-off-the-record.name: Off the Record
hr.lawyer-off-the-record.desc: Never says anything near a journalist. Including "pass the extinguisher".
hr.librarian-quiet-please.name: Quiet, Please
hr.librarian-quiet-please.desc: Finally, a building that respects silence. Hears everything coming.
hr.librarian-noise-complaint.name: Noise Complaint
hr.librarian-noise-complaint.desc: Has filed nine noise complaints about a teammate. All unanswered.
hr.life-coach-a-project.name: A Project
hr.life-coach-a-project.desc: A teammate who needs fixing. The life coach has never been more alive.
hr.life-coach-qualifications-question.de: Facing someone with an actual licence. Avoids eye contact.
hr.lifeguard-near-water.name: Near Water
hr.lifeguard-near-water.desc: Smells the sea and switches on. Whistle in teeth, eyes on everyone.
hr.lifeguard-thirty-minutes-after-eating: Will not move at full speed for thirty minutes after eating. Professional rule.
hr.magician-booked-venue.name: Booked Venue
hr.magician-booked-venue.desc: Has played this room. The trapdoors are friends.
hr.magician-saw-the-trick-coming.name: Saw the Trick Coming
hr.magician-saw-the-trick-coming.desc: A teammate keeps predicting every trick out loud. Ruins the reveal. Every time.
hr.marine-biologist-field-work.name: Field Work
hr.marine-biologist-field-work.desc: Docks count as field work. Expenses claim already filed.
hr.marine-biologist-seafood-special.name: Seafood Special
hr.marine-biologist-seafood-special.desc: A teammate described their favourite crab recipe. In detail. Before the fight.
hr.mechanic-proper-tools.name: Proper Tools
hr.mechanic-proper-tools.desc: Give them the right tools and they'll fix anything, including the other team.
hr.mechanic-that-noise-again.name: That Noise Again
hr.mechanic-that-noise-again.desc: A teammate keeps describing a noise their car makes. "Like a clunk, but softer".
hr.mime-invisible-wall-practice.name: Invisible Wall Practice
hr.mime-invisible-wall-practice.desc: A real stage. The invisible box has never been more convincing.
hr.mime-too-loud.name: Too Loud
hr.mime-too-loud.desc: A loud teammate. The mime covers their ears. Silently. Constantly.
hr.museum-curator-my-collection.name: My Collection
hr.museum-curator-my-collection.desc: Fighting among their own exhibits. Knows exactly which vase is a replica.
hr.museum-curator-disputed-provenance.de: The urn belongs to the museum. The archaeologist disagrees. Loudly.
hr.nurse-ward-round.name: Ward Round
hr.nurse-ward-round.desc: Another clinician in the squad means someone to hand over to. Bliss.
hr.nurse-another-incident-form.name: Another Incident Form
hr.nurse-another-incident-form.desc: A clumsy teammate means paperwork. Nurse is already filling it in.
hr.painter-dust-sheets-down.name: Dust Sheets Down
hr.painter-dust-sheets-down.desc: A building that's half done. They know where the wet paint is. The others don't.
hr.painter-fussy-about-grain.name: Fussy About Grain
hr.painter-fussy-about-grain.desc: The carpenter "doesn't want it painted". Then why ask a painter?
hr.paramedic-blue-light-bond.name: Blue Light Bond
hr.paramedic-blue-light-bond.desc: Another emergency service in the squad. Sirens on.
hr.paramedic-self-medicating.name: Self-Medicating
hr.paramedic-self-medicating.desc: Knows exactly what's in that packet. Takes it anyway. Tougher, foggier.
hr.personal-trainer-counting-steps.name: Counting Steps
hr.personal-trainer-counting-steps.desc: With a tracker on, every punch counts towards the daily goal.
hr.personal-trainer-lazy-clients.name: Lazy Clients
hr.personal-trainer-lazy-clients.desc: A lazy teammate. Trainer keeps shouting "one more rep" at them instead of fighting.
hr.photographer-unflattering-angle.name: Unflattering Angle
hr.photographer-unflattering-angle.desc: Knows the opposition's worst angle. Goes for it.
hr.photographer-phones-away.name: Phones Away, Please
hr.photographer-phones-away.desc: Told to put the camera away at the door. Has not put the camera away.
hr.plumber-ensuite-season.name: En-Suite Season
hr.plumber-ensuite-season.desc: Every building with a lot of bathrooms is a building they understand.
hr.plumber-live-wires.name: Live Wires
hr.plumber-live-wires.desc: The electrician is in the squad. Plumber has turned the water off. Everywhere. Just in case.
hr.police-officer-known-to-police.name: Known to Police
hr.police-officer-known-to-police.desc: Recognises someone on the other side. Has a file on them too.
hr.police-officer-paperwork.name: Paperwork
hr.police-officer-paperwork.desc: A lawyer on the other side. Every punch will be a form.
hr.politician-photo-op.name: Photo Op
hr.politician-photo-op.desc: A big name on the other side. Makes sure to be seen shaking their hand, then hitting them.
hr.politician-hostile-press.name: Hostile Press
hr.politician-hostile-press.desc: Press in the squad. Every gaffe will be on the front page.
hr.postal-worker-proper-bag.name: Proper Bag
hr.postal-worker-proper-bag.desc: A good bag and they can carry anything, including a grudge.
hr.postal-worker-smells-of-dog.name: Smells of Dog
hr.postal-worker-smells-of-dog.desc: A teammate smells of dog. Postal worker is twitchy and keeps checking behind them.
hr.programmer-headphones-on.name: Headphones On
hr.programmer-headphones-on.desc: Headphones on means "in the zone". Do not disturb. Do not punch.
hr.programmer-onboarding-the-temp.name: Onboarding the Temp
hr.programmer-onboarding-the-temp.desc: Has to explain everything to the temp. Again. Fighting on half a brain.
hr.psychologist-unlicensed.name: Unlicensed Practice
hr.psychologist-unlicensed.desc: Facing someone without qualifications. Polite, clinical and very, very motivated.
hr.psychologist-off-the-clock.name: Off the Clock
hr.psychologist-off-the-clock.desc: A teammate keeps wanting to "talk about it". Mid-fight. Unbilled.
hr.sailor-shore-leave.name: Shore Leave
hr.sailor-shore-leave.desc: Back at the docks. Feels the boards under their feet and grins.
hr.sailor-landlubber-transport.name: Landlubber Transport
hr.sailor-landlubber-transport.desc: Doesn't trust anything without a hull. Spends the fight looking for life jackets.
hr.scientist-peer-reviewed-eyewear.name: Peer-Reviewed Eyewear
hr.scientist-misinformation.name: Misinformation
hr.scientist-misinformation.desc: A teammate is spreading misinformation. The scientist is drafting a rebuttal instead of fighting.
hr.security-guard-night-shift-habitat.de: Has walked these aisles a thousand times at 3 a.m. Knows every shadow.
hr.security-guard-real-police.name: "Real" Police
hr.security-guard-real-police.desc: The police officer called them "mall cop". In front of everyone.
hr.tailor-proper-tailoring.name: Proper Tailoring
hr.tailor-proper-tailoring.desc: Dressed properly at last. Stands taller. Hits straighter.
hr.tailor-couture-vs-craft.name: Couture vs Craft
hr.tailor-couture-vs-craft.desc: The designer calls it "a look". The tailor calls it "pinned wrong".
hr.tattoo-artist-old-clients.name: Old Clients
hr.tattoo-artist-old-clients.desc: Half the docks are wearing their work. Waves at people mid-fight.
hr.tattoo-artist-hygiene-inspection.name: Hygiene Inspection
hr.tattoo-artist-hygiene-inspection.desc: A medical colleague keeps asking about their autoclave. Pointedly.
hr.taxi-driver-airport-run.name: Airport Run
hr.taxi-driver-airport-run.desc: Knows every short cut to the terminal. And every short cut inside it.
hr.taxi-driver-bus-lane-grudge.name: Bus Lane Grudge
hr.taxi-driver-bus-lane-grudge.desc: Thirty years of bus lanes. The bus driver is not forgiven.
hr.teacher-school-trip.name: School Trip
hr.teacher-school-trip.desc: Has done this museum with thirty Year 7s. A fight is nothing.
hr.teacher-disruptive-pupil.name: Disruptive Pupil
hr.teacher-disruptive-pupil.desc: A teammate behaves like the back row. Teacher keeps telling them off instead of fighting.
hr.train-conductor-platform-authority.de: On a platform, everyone listens to the whistle.
hr.train-conductor-rail-replacement-insu: The bus driver keeps calling themselves "the real railway". It burns.
hr.tv-host-ratings-gold.name: Ratings Gold
hr.tv-host-ratings-gold.desc: A famous opponent. The cameras are rolling. Big show energy.
hr.tv-host-upstaged.name: Upstaged
hr.tv-host-upstaged.desc: The influencer has more followers. The TV host has read the numbers. Twice.
hr.veterinarian-shop-talk.name: Shop Talk
hr.veterinarian-shop-talk.desc: Another animal person in the squad. They swap stories between punches.
hr.veterinarian-wrong-kind-of-doctor.des: Keeps being asked to "have a look at a patient". The patients are not dogs.
hr.welder-hot-work.name: Hot Work
hr.welder-hot-work.desc: Steel all around. Feels at home.
hr.welder-permit-inspection.name: Permit Inspection
hr.welder-permit-inspection.desc: The firefighter wants to see a hot-work permit. Before every fight.
hr.window-cleaner-seen-it-all.name: Seen It All
hr.window-cleaner-seen-it-all.desc: Has cleaned these windows for years. Knows everyone's secrets. Everyone knows they know.
hr.window-cleaner-no-windows.name: No Windows
hr.window-cleaner-no-windows.desc: A building without windows. What are they even for here?
hr.zookeeper-smells-of-zoo.name: Smells of the Zoo
hr.zookeeper-smells-of-zoo.desc: An opponent afraid of animals. The zookeeper smells strongly of animals.
hr.zookeeper-taxidermy.name: Taxidermy
hr.zookeeper-taxidermy.desc: Saw the stuffed animals in the museum. Will not be the same.
